title: Prepare release gate; defer publication until corrective Work Items close
outOfScope: Changing runtime security boundaries or implementing a security sandbox
Changing release workflow policy, branch protection, signing infrastructure, or SBOM/provenance generators
Creating a public provider tag, release, or asset; publication belongs to a later dedicated WI-18 Work Item
Publishing before every release, Japanese, Trust Layer, CI, supply-chain, installer, compatibility, and human-authorization gate passes
Deleting historical Work Item evidence or execution plans

sources.reason: Published release identity and current public archive contract.
Candidate release identity and delegated supply-chain evidence projection.
Canonical release lifecycle state and source identity.
Authoritative provider release and evidence sequence.
Fail-closed release identity and lifecycle preflight.
User-authorized serial Work Item order and release blockers.
Mandatory pre-release Human-Agent Trust Layer gate.
Governance capability mapping for release operation.

riskAssessment.reason: Public immutable tags and assets must be bound to one exact source commit and all delegated evidence before publication.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial execution and one release after every mandatory gate passes; no gate bypass is authorized.

preReviewWarnings: Do not publish a stale, candidate, historical, or conflicting identity; record exact source, tag, assets, checksums, URLs, run IDs, and authorization.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: WI-16 Japanese capability assessment and WI-17 Human-Agent Trust Layer are verified as merged and closed predecessors.
The release preparation records the observed release identity conflict, stale candidate evidence, and exact fail-closed distribution/preflight results without mutating provider state.

The preparation boundary explicitly separates candidate preparation from provider publication and records that publication is deferred until WI-20 omissions, outstanding process issues, and RFE-ISSUE-082 are resolved.
Relevant local release-state consistency checks pass, while any public distribution mismatch remains recorded as an unresolved release blocker rather than being hidden.
No provider release, immutable tag, or public asset is created by this preparation Work Item.
The complete Contract, preflight, implementation, verification, Summary, PR, CI, merge, ai-close, branch-cleanup, and main-sync lifecycle succeeds.
Every process issue is recorded in the plan; workflow defects are corrected and affected gates rerun before publication continues.
guidelines: Release claims must be backed by source-bound evidence rather than self-declaration.
Do not publish when any required gate is missing, stale, contradictory, or unverifiable.
Preserve the distinction between delegated SBOM/Provenance evidence and AI Cockpit governance evidence.
Keep release identity and evidence machine-readable and reproducible.

intent.problem: The remediation sequence requires one real new version publication after the Japanese and Human-Agent Trust Layer gates, but release truth must remain bound to one exact source commit and must not be inferred from candidate or historical metadata.
constraints: Use the latest synchronized origin/main after all predecessor Work Items are closed.
Fail closed on release preflight, CI, supply-chain, installer, compatibility, and human-decision gates.
Do not claim enterprise compliance, sandboxing, signing, identity, or isolation without evidence.
Do not delete historical evidence or execution plans.
intent.rationale: A real release validates that governance, Japanese, documentation, installer, and supply-chain evidence remain aligned at publication time.

rawUserRequest: 继续执行已授权的 AI Cockpit 全面整改计划。WI-18 必须在全面日语评估和 Human-Agent Trust Layer 工单完成并关闭后发布新版本；发布前必须走 release freeze、release preflight、PR/CI、SBOM、provenance、漏洞/secret 检查、安装器与兼容性验证、版本/标签/资产/校验和/证据记录及人类授权。每个工单必须完成完整 PR、合并、归档、清理分支和同步 main 的生命周期；遇到流程问题要记录，流程问题先修流程再继续。

authorityEvidence.scope: Continue serial Work Item execution and prepare release evidence, while deferring all public publication until the five-stage order is complete; no gate bypass authorized.

declaredIntent.summary: Prepare and record the source-bound release gate state only; defer the next public release to a later dedicated WI-18 Work Item.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A stale, candidate, historical, or conflicting release identity is detected.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Release preparation fails closed for publication and no tag or public asset is created.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A mandatory Japanese or Trust Layer predecessor is not merged and closed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Work Item stops before publication and records missing predecessor evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Archive, installer, SBOM, provenance, vulnerability/secret, hosted CI, compatibility, or digest evidence is missing or source-mismatched.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The relevant gate fails closed and publication does not proceed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: All deterministic preparation gates pass but corrective Work Items remain open.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Preparation records the release blocker and defers provider publication; no external release operation is executed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A workflow/process defect is found during release preparation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Record it, correct the workflow or stop, rerun affected gates, and never continue on stale evidence.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized serial remediation, release publication, and correction of workflow defects before continuing; no gate bypass is authorized.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
